title: Panel Update
desc: Updates the panel to the latest version on GitHub. Data (env, database, sites) is preserved; if the new version doesn't start healthy, it's rolled back automatically.
desc_tool_missing: Update tool is not on the server — it will be downloaded automatically on first run.
running: Update running — the panel may restart briefly, don't close this page.
confirm_prompt: The panel will be updated and the service will restart. Do you confirm?
